comparison.allocator_statistic: descriptive median of three paired screening repeats

additional_controls_before_adoption: ordinary non-managed and fallback performance controls
confirmation.allocator: fresh plan with three paired AB/BA repeats, 2 warmups, 10 samples per child
confirmation.native: fresh plan with six ABBA/BAAB blocks, 20 warmups, 200 samples per child
confirmation.when: only after a qualifying screen signal and all safety/oracle/control checks pass

execution.process_group: start_new_session; bounded SIGTERM then SIGKILL; reap and verify clear

allocator.role: descriptive counter evidence; no latency or adoption inference

gates.ci: No confidence interval or statistically qualified benefit is emitted for screening; full confirmation uses the frozen0959 bootstrap protocol.
gates.full_followup: Any promising or ambiguous signal requires a fresh six-block/200-sample native and separately bound allocator confirmation.
gates.full_followup_interpretation: Required before adoption only. Root pre-capture selection rule determines whether candidate advances or is rejected.

memory_control.scope: whole process including setup and oracle work

gates.no_gate_relaxation: full confirmation retains the adopted 0959 5% point and CI gates; screening cannot adopt
gates.screening_safety: Any custody, terminal, report, semantic, inverse, resource, allocator, or control failure rejects without retry; native primary/native RSS/allocator region peak/allocator RSS median >1.05 stops.
gates.useful_signal: native primary or native max_rss_kib or allocator region_peak_live_bytes median <=0.95; requested bytes/calls alone never signal

purpose: Prospective descriptive screening of a bounded MultiSourceEdit::apply_batch capacity hint; screening cannot authorize adoption.

quality.scope: full 1403 on production-final source before final test-only additions; final focused34, Clippy and scoped format

allocator.allocation_scope: global system-allocator callbacks serialized by allocation_metrics; process-wide across threads; observer peaks are not RSS, unique heap, per-thread bytes, OS-thread counts, or timing
allocator.performance_claim: none; allocator counters do not claim latency, throughput, RSS, OS-thread width, worker/task overlap, speedup, or adoption; procfs Threads values are quiescence observations only
allocator.scope: process-wide serialized allocator regions with exact phase conservation; no latency or adoption claim

native.performance_claim: none; raw phase timings describe this explicit in-memory harness and do not claim OS thread counts, speedup, allocation behavior, or physical I/O
native.scope: timed in-memory phase report with source/output/semantic/resource oracles outside timers

reused_0959.reuse_policy: import only nearest-rank/geometric-mean/ratio/bootstrap after exact SHA validation; schedule and sample-count validation is 0960-specific
